acceptance_profile.visibility_and_provenance: Hidden destinations, undiscovered routes and GM-only transit facts remain visibility/GM-owned; AI cannot reveal them by authority and proposals cannot mutate canon.

acceptance_profile.determinism: Equivalent normalized portal/gate/transit inputs produce identical deterministic checksums across supported platforms.
